'''Metaphysical Serum''' is an {{Epic}} [[Permanent Consumable]] item obtained rarely in [[Experiments|Superpairs]].

== Obtaining ==
'''Metaphysical Serum''' is a {{Chance|1.0638%|162|15625}} chance drop from Experiments, obtainable from {{yellow|Grand}} experiments or higher.

== Usage ==
The player can consume up to 3 '''Metaphysical Serums''', which each give a permanent buff shortening the chain required in Superpairs add-on experiments by 1 and granting the player {{SBXP|+5}} up to {{SBXP|+15}} when all three are consumed.

Additionally, after consuming all three '''Metaphysical Serums''', you will be rewarded with a permanent +2 clicks in Superpairs.
